tvShow.name: Sullivan's Crossing
tvShow.overview: After Neurosurgeon Maggie Sullivan’s personal and professional life are thrown into turmoil she returns home to Sullivan’s Crossing. While there, Maggie is forced to navigate her complicated present while confronting the painful past she has chosen to ignore for years.

episodes.name: Coming Home
episodes.overview: When neurosurgeon Maggie Sullivan's seemingly perfect life in Boston is turned upside down, she leaves the city and her boyfriend, Andrew, to return to her childhood home of Sullivan's Crossing in Nova Scotia.

episodes.name: Homewrecker
episodes.overview: Maggie sees Cal in a new light after they help an injured resident and spend time together at karaoke.

episodes.name: Detours
episodes.overview: Sydney attempts to cheer up Maggie after she suffers a setback back at home. Frank and Edna help Sully, with the annual land blessing, but the festivities end early after a camper goes missing. Maggie and Cal work together with the search and rescue team unaware that another life hangs in the balance.

episodes.name: Rock and a Hard Place
episodes.overview: Maggie and Cal work against the clock in a daring medical rescue, and in the process discover a clue to the whereabouts of a missing camper. Maggie learns a little more about Cal’s past, while Sully receives disturbing news.

episodes.name: Pressure Drop
episodes.overview: Maggie makes a difficult decision after Sully lets his temper get the best of him.

episodes.name: Boiling Point
episodes.overview: Sully tries to hold things together at Sullivan's Crossing, while Maggie attempts to navigate complications back in Boston, Mass.

episodes.name: Second Chances
episodes.overview: Tensions escalate as Maggie returns to Sullivan's Crossing with Andrew.

episodes.name: Aftershock
episodes.overview: Maggie struggles to make sense of her personal life. Sully deals with some financial challenges.

episodes.name: Can't Help Falling
episodes.overview: Maggie's medical training is put to the test as she races against the clock to save the life of a friend.

episodes.name: Sins of the Father
episodes.overview: Maggie returns to Boston prepared to face the consequences of her actions, while Cal searches for closure of his own.

episodes.name: Guilt Trip
episodes.overview: Maggie Sullivan returns to the Crossing to find Sully in the hospital, struggling with the feeling that he's forgotten something; Cal Jones is confused when Maggie gives him the cold shoulder, unaware that Lola pocketed his goodbye letter.

episodes.name: A Storm Is Brewing
episodes.overview: Maggie searches for clues regarding the cause of Sully's condition as she struggles to make a decision about her own future.

episodes.name: Confessions
episodes.overview: Maggie, Cal, Lola, and Sydney help Edna prepare the campground for a storm as Frank helps Sully to figure out what's been eating at him.

episodes.name: Eye of the Storm
episodes.overview: Things start to heat up between Maggie and Cal when they're forced to take shelter at Cal's cabin.

episodes.name: Secrets
episodes.overview: Uncertain about her own future as well as that of the Crossing, Maggie tries to find a way to help Sully.

episodes.name: Revelations
episodes.overview: Maggie's world is turned upside down after she learns some devastating news about her stepfather.

episodes.name: Reunions
episodes.overview: Reeling over the news of Maggie's pregnancy, Cal receives a visitor; Phoebe and Sully start to bond over the idea of being grandparents.

episodes.name: Truth and Consequences
episodes.overview: Maggie helps care for Cal's sister and in the process learns more about his past.

episodes.name: Remorse
episodes.overview: Maggie enlists Cal’s help when Sully becomes convinced he needs to take drastic measures to make amends with Lola.

episodes.name: It's a Wonderful Life
episodes.overview: Cal works with Maggie as she fights to save the Crossing, while a careless mistake may cost someone their life.

episodes.name: New Beginnings
episodes.overview: Maggie tries to embrace her new life at the Crossing as she struggles to move past the loss she suffered the night of the diner fire.

episodes.name: Out of the Blue
episodes.overview: Maggie and Cal's relationship starts to heat up; Sully realizes he has some things in common with Helen.

episodes.name: The Ties That Bind
episodes.overview: Maggie accompanies Cal to visit his parents; Sully and Frank get to the bottom of who's behind the new development.

episodes.name: A Clear Perspective
episodes.overview: Maggie tries to help Cal deal with his conflicted feelings towards his father; Sully worries about how he will compete with the new development.

episodes.name: Misunderstandings
episodes.overview: Maggie grows concerned about Cal after he makes a series of rash decisions, while an unexpected visitor threatens Sully and Rob's plans for the diner.

episodes.name: Bad Timing
episodes.overview: Everyone at the Crossing pitches in to try and help Rob save his new restaurant while Maggie and Cal continue to drift apart.

episodes.name: Twists and Turns
episodes.overview: Everyone at the Crossing bands together to look for Lola and Jacob when it comes to light that the two never made it home from the woods.

episodes.name: Blindsided
episodes.overview: As Glenn's condition deteriorates, Maggie thinks there may be a connection to a firefighter who collapsed during renovations at the lodge.

episodes.name: First Cut is the Deepest
episodes.overview: Maggie faces a difficult decision after a loved one becomes ill.

episodes.name: Head to the Heart
episodes.overview: Cal believes that Maggie's missing her career, while relationships come to a head at the opening of Rob's restaurant.

episodes.name: Curveballs
episodes.overview: As Maggie digs into the reasons for her ex-husband Liam's return, Cal finds himself struggling with feelings of jealousy as tensions at the Crossing rise.

episodes.name: Open Wounds
episodes.overview: Maggie and Cal continue to deal with the fallout of Liam's arrival.

episodes.name: Northern Lights
episodes.overview: Maggie looks for a doctor to support her application to the board of physicians and Cal discovers information that causes him to question Maggie's history with Liam.

episodes.name: Gut Instincts
episodes.overview: Maggie's residency gets off to a rocky start as Cal shows Ben the ropes at the Crossing and begins to wonder if Liam has any intention of leaving.

episodes.name: Abandoning
episodes.overview: Maggie tries to figure out what's causing Tracy's fever as Cal learns that Ben hasn't been honest with them and Liam finally comes clean about what happened in the past.

episodes.name: Falling Through the Cracks
episodes.overview: After learning the truth, Maggie struggles to reconcile her unresolved feelings for Liam while helping Cal look for Ben and Tracy.

episodes.name: Face the Music
episodes.overview: Maggie struggles to find the right time to come clean about what happened with Liam while Cal gets an unexpected visitor.

episodes.name: Let it Go
episodes.overview: The rift between Cal and Maggie widens as Liam decides he's staying at the Crossing.

episodes.name: We Can Work It Out
episodes.overview: A casual outing takes a perilous turn after Maggie agrees to let Liam try and cheer her up.

episodes.name: Healing Hearts
episodes.overview: While everyone gathers to celebrate the land ceremony, Maggie makes a difficult decision as she faces the fact she may have lost Cal for good.
